function use(items, operation, n) {
	const cap = Math.min(1, n);
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript-options
	mapLimit(items, operation, { concurrency: 1 });
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript-options
	mapLimit({ maxConcurrency: 1 }, items, operation);
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript-options
	mapLimit(items, { max_concurrency: 1 }, operation);
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript-options
	mapLimit(items, operation, { width: 1 });
	// ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-javascript-options
	mapLimit(items, operation, { limit: 1 });
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	mapLimit(items, Math.min(1, n), operation);
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	mapLimit(items, Math.min(n, 1), operation);
	// ok: serial-bounded-helper-javascript
	mapLimit(items, cap, operation);
	mapLimit(items, operation, { maxConcurrency: 4 });
	mapLimit(items, operation, { concurrency: n });
	mapLimit(items, Math.min(4, n), operation);
	mapLimit(items, n, operation);
	mapLimit(items, Math.max(1, n), operation);
	mapLimit(items, n + 1, operation);
	mapLimit(items, Math.min(4, n + 1), operation);
}
